translations.web: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
translations.bsb: You will lie down without fear, and many will court your favor.
translations.kjv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
translations.asv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
